definition: In statistics, EM (expectation maximization) algorithm handles latent variables, while GMM is the Gaussian mixture model..
details: In statistics, EM (expectation maximization) algorithm handles latent variables, while GMM is the Gaussian mixture model.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. That is EM algorithm and GMM model — a small key that opens a big door.
